inputs.research_scope: 94 game/edition/layout records; 2195 binding rows inherited from R2; no catalogue expansion or fresh complete-source verification claimed.

model.movement: WASD thumbstick consumes the thumb as one resource, including diagonal movement.
model.selector_access: For static testing, a non-BASIC bank is accessed by a held little-finger selector after recognition. This is a hypothesis, not a configured v2 gesture.
model.meaning_of_pass: A route exists with different hypothesized fingers for concurrent left-hand outputs, the layer selector and optional stick movement. Reach, grip, press direction, timings, release order, software support and game recognition remain unverified.
model.meaning_of_fail: No independent-finger route was found in this model. It is a risk/unknown, not proof the human hand cannot press these switches together.

gesture.historical_preference: V short tap / exclusive 150 ms long-hold momentary layer; release returns, previously configured in v1.5.6 only.
gesture.not_authorized: Do not silently replace historical or later user choices, bind an exclusive layer hold to an urgent held game key, or install guessed JSON.
transition_contract: No nested held layers in the proposed first test; release a selector before selecting a different bank.
Common logical outputs stay in place. Always preserve original output ownership and test key-up transitions; identical labels alone do not prove a safe transition.
No injected input, global recording, profile installation or game launch is part of these artifacts.

why_empty: Under the conservative momentary model the little finger already holds the selector. Filling the rest of that column would overstate independent access.
function_number_alignment: F1–F9 are at the same positions as 1–9 in NUMBERS. F10–F12 use the separate bottom row.
raw_key_qualification: Ctrl/Shift/Alt are logical names; left/right variants, keyboard layout and actual scan codes must be reconciled with the native export. Top-row numbers are not numpad numbers.

variants.applies_to: A game that needs WASD movement and an independent arrow-key action pad at the same time.
variants.cost: Replaces the direct 1–4 copies; the complete number bank remains. Right/left share one column and up/down share another; opposite directions are not a simultaneous target.
variants.not_a_game_default: This is a proposed access variant, not evidence that every game needs both directional groups.

variants.applies_to: Urgent 5–0, repeated Ctrl-number combat actions, or F-key target switching.
variants.preferred_order: First rebind only the specific urgent game action to a direct existing output where the game supports it; otherwise evaluate a hotbar Base using this same utility family.
variants.cost: Do not claim placing an urgent input behind a layer solves its reaction requirement. A supported per-game rebind is a proposal, not an already applied setting.

sources.limit: Co-holding Tab+2/3/4 is a derived compound from adjacent definitions. Movement during these chords was not measured or verified.

sources.supports: Shift+C, Shift+V, and Shift+1/2/3/4 are documented keyboard shortcuts.
sources.limit: Distinct-finger demand and simultaneous movement are analysis constraints, not an empirical timing study.

sources.supports: X/C are the red pair; Z/V are the blue pair. Large notes use both inputs of the corresponding pair; opposite colors together are not a required valid pair.
sources.limit: Article carries a cleanup notice. No claim about individual comfort or maximum tapping rate.

sources.supports: The default healing skill is 6. Some numbered and function-key actions are combat inputs.
